item.title: Amazon turned its Alexa robot into a Ring security patrol bot
item.description: As part of a new brand called Ring Robotics - designed to take a more proactive approach to security instead of just monitoring - a new rolling mobile security camera was announced by Amazon, called the Ring Rover Cam. It borrows a lot of the design and functionality from the Astro home robot that Amazon first debuted in 2021 . The Rover Cam is targeted at businesses in need of an affordable security solution that can patrol and investigate concerns in large facilities, and it comes with a few upgrades. item.title: Hands-on with Ring’s new AI drone camera for your home
item.description: Ring’s new Drone Cam is a flying indoor security camera. Ring is finally shipping a flying indoor drone camera. For real this time. The Ring Drone Cam will arrive on January 27th, 2027, for $249.99 , Ring founder Jamie Siminoff said at a launch event in New York City this week. If it does actually ship, it will arrive almost six years after the company announced its first flying camera, the Ring Always Home Cam. Designed to patrol inside your home when you're not there, the Drone Cam is an AI-powered drone that can react to triggers from Ring sensors, such as detecting motion, a door opening, a water leak, or an alarm sounding. When triggered, it flies along pre-programmed routes to a set location … Read the full story at The Verge.

item.title: Obi will run to Cameroon if confronted with burdens of presidency – Wike
item.description: By Omeiza Ajayi, Abuja Minister of the Federal Capital Territory FCT, Nyesom Wike, has accused the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), Peter Obi, of lacking the capacity to tackle the myriads of Nigeria’s challenges but would instead flee to Cameroon if handed the responsibilities of the presidency. Wike spoke on Tuesday at the Abaji Area Council Rainbow Coalition and Stakeholders’ Meeting in Abuja, where he urged FCT residents to back President Bola Tinubu’s re-election bid in 2027. He said Obi would run away from the country’s problems instead of tackling them headlong, unlike Tinubu, whom he praised for taking difficult decisions. According to the minister, Nigeria needs a president who can confront hard situations and not abandon the country when challenges arise. He argued that the presidency is not a position for political theatrics or public relations but one that demands courage, capacity and the willingness to take responsibility. Wike asked the Abaji leaders to prove their support for Tinubu at the polls. He warned political leaders against making promises they cannot fulfil and said he would judge them by their ability to deliver their wards for the President in 2027. “Let me repeat what I said yesterday. To the people of Abaji, through their chairman, councillors and leaders, you come from different wards. You have told me you will vote for Tinubu. I have no problem with that. I want to see it,” he said. He specifically charged the Abaji Area Council chairman and other leaders to secure victory for Tinubu in their wards, stressing that leadership must be shown through electoral results. The minister said the FCT must not only match Rivers State in electoral performance but surpass it, adding that he was ready to apply the same political mobilisation strategy in Abuja. “Nobody is competing with Rivers. I don’t know what you all think. The only people who are going to compete with Rivers are the FCT. Whatever I will do there, I will do it here. So make sure you beat Rivers,” Wike said. Wike also cautioned residents against repeating what he described as the mistake of the 2023 elections, when they allegedly voted for candidates who did not keep in touch with their constituents after winning. “You went and elected somebody you don’t know. Is it not correct? Have you seen the person again? Has he come to address you? Has he asked you what your problems are? Has he moved anything that will affect the interest of the FCT?” he asked. The minister disclosed that he would meet FCT youths on Wednesday to discuss political mobilisation and other issues affecting their participation in the forthcoming elections. item.title: Ogun Gov Poll: PDP candidate’s name not in party’s register, INEC tells court
item.description: … as LP chieftain alleges plot to compromise judge By Ikechukwu Nnochiri ABUJA — The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) has explained to the Federal High Court in Abuja why it excluded Ogun State PDP candidate Mr Ladi Adebutu from its list of candidates cleared for the 2027 general elections. In a counter-affidavit deposed to by Mr Mustapha Mohammed, a Chief Program Analyst in its Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Department, the Commission told the court that Adebutu’s name was not found in the register of members the PDP earlier submitted to it. It told the court that it found only the name of the PDP’s deputy governorship candidate in the state, Kolapo Lateefat Oyeyemi, in the register. INEC’s counter-affidavit was in opposition to a suit marked FHC/ABJ/CS/2573/2026, which the PDP and its Ogun State governorship candidate, Adebutu, filed against it. While the PDP is the 1st plaintiff in the matter, Adebutu is listed as the 2nd plaintiff, with INEC named as the sole defendant. It will be recalled that INEC had omitted Adebutu’s name from the final list of 13 candidates cleared to contest the Ogun State governorship election billed for February 6, 2027. Dissatisfied with the action, the PDP approached the court for an order compelling INEC to reverse its decision by recognising Adebutu’s candidacy. However, in the process it filed to challenge the competence of the suit, INEC said it had done due diligence before the final list of candidates for the election was published. item.dc:creator: Nwafor
item.content:encoded: … as LP chieftain alleges plot to compromise judge By Ikechukwu Nnochiri ABUJA — The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) has explained to the Federal High Court in Abuja why it excluded Ogun State PDP candidate Mr Ladi Adebutu from its list of candidates cleared for the 2027 general elections. In a counter-affidavit deposed to by Mr Mustapha Mohammed, a Chief Program Analyst in its Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Department, the Commission told the court that Adebutu’s name was not found in the register of members the PDP earlier submitted to it. It told the court that it found only the name of the PDP’s deputy governorship candidate in the state, Kolapo Lateefat Oyeyemi, in the register. INEC’s counter-affidavit was in opposition to a suit marked FHC/ABJ/CS/2573/2026, which the PDP and its Ogun State governorship candidate, Adebutu, filed against it. While the PDP is the 1st plaintiff in the matter, Adebutu is listed as the 2nd plaintiff, with INEC named as the sole defendant. It will be recalled that INEC had omitted Adebutu’s name from the final list of 13 candidates cleared to contest the Ogun State governorship election billed for February 6, 2027. Dissatisfied with the action, the PDP approached the court for an order compelling INEC to reverse its decision by recognising Adebutu’s candidacy. However, in the process it filed to challenge the competence of the suit, INEC said it had done due diligence before the final list of candidates for the election was published. According to the deponent, “I know as a fact that before the Governorship Candidates Final List was published, the ICT department conducted a search on the membership register submitted by the 1st plaintiff and during the search, the ICT department found the name of the 1st plaintiff’s candidate fielded as Deputy Governor of Ogun State (Kolapo Lateefat Oyeyemi) in the register but could not find the name of the 2nd plaintiff. “The search was also conducted to find a possible match for the name of the 2nd plaintiff, but no possible match was found in the Ogun State membership register. “That I know as a fact that all the queries conducted on the membership register in the flash drives (PDF/read only) submitted to the defendant by the 1st plaintiff do not contain the name of the 2nd plaintiff. “That the flash drive attached to the plaintiff’s affidavit and further affidavit in support of the Originating Summons was shown to me and I have carefully examined it, and I state that the contents of the flash drive are not the same as those submitted to the defendant. “That the first flash drive submitted by the 1st plaintiff to the defendant on 22 April 2026 had files named Ogun 01-038, while the second flash drive submitted to the defendant had files named Ogun 01-04, with serial numbers of members 1–18,973 and 1–19,308 respectively. “That serial number 1536 on the membership register submitted by the 1st plaintiff to the defendant contains the name of one Lugboso Sunday Seun and not the name of the 2nd plaintiff,” INEC’s witness further averred. It told the court that two flash drives were submitted to it alongside the hard-copy membership register, and neither contained the name and particulars of the 2nd plaintiff, Adebutu. Following the adoption of final addresses by the parties, Justice Peter Lifu fixed Friday for judgment. Meanwhile, a chieftain of the Labour Party (LP), Arabambi Abayomi, has alleged a plot to compromise the court into bypassing the Supreme Court judgment that activated Section 287(1) of the 1999 Constitution, as amended, and compelled INEC to exclude political parties that failed to comply with Section 77(5)–(7) of the Electoral Act, 2026, in relation to the fielding of candidates. Abayomi, in a statement he made available to newsmen, further accused the Ogun State PDP candidate of perjury, alleging that he made false claims in an affidavit he deposed to in support of the suit against INEC. “The specific serial number Adebutu swore belonged to him—Serial Number 1536—actually belongs to one Lugboso Sunday Seun. INEC’s searches of the authentic registers found no match for Adebutu’s name whatsoever. “For a litigant to approach the Federal High Court and swear to an affidavit containing demonstrably false particulars is perjury. “It is an affront to the administration of justice. The evidential weight against Adebutu is not merely unfavourable, it is devastating,” Abayomi stated. Besides urging the Attorney General of the Federation to initiate an investigation into the alleged perjury, he called on the Chief Justice of Nigeria and the Chief Judge of the Federal High Court to look into the alleged plot to influence the outcome of the case. The post Ogun Gov Poll: PDP candidate’s name not in party’s register, INEC tells court appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: 'It didn’t sit very well' - Julian Alvarez's Atletico Madrid teammates 'annoyed' by public transfer plea to join Barcelona
item.description: Julian Alvarez - Getty Images Julian Alvarez’s public transfer demand caused significant frustration within the Atletico Madrid dressing room, according to team-mate Alex Baena. The Argentina forward pushed for a summer move to Barcelona, leading to internal tension and a hostile reception from supporters at the Metropolitano. Alvarez transfer demands angered Atletico team-mates Alvarez's public plea to leave Atletico caused significant unrest among his team-mates. The Argentina international expressed a strong desire to secure a transfer away from the club in June, publicly stating that a move would be best for all parties. Barcelona emerged as the primary suitors for the highly-rated forward. Joan Laporta confirmed the Catalan club's interest in August, but Atletico firmly refused to sanction a sale during a drawn-out summer saga. The failed transfer resulted in a difficult situation for Alvarez in the Spanish capital. He faced intense scrutiny from supporters and sparked frustration from his colleagues inside the dressing room. Baena reveals dressing room frustrations Spain midfielder Baena has now shed light on exactly how the squad reacted to the transfer saga. Speaking to Cadena SER on Monday night, he admitted that Alvarez's public approach caused unnecessary friction behind the scenes. "It feels a bit strange when a team-mate says publicly that he wants to leave," Baena explained during the radio interview. "It didn’t sit very well with us. I can understand a player having doubts if a club like Barca or Real Madrid comes in for you, but, ultimately, it was the way he went about it that really annoyed us at Atletico." Rebuilding relationships at the Metropolitano Alvarez eventually apologised to Atletico fans in October following his controversial summer comments. While the intense whistling from the Metropolitano crowd at the start of the season has slightly subsided, some hostility remains clearly audible during matches. Despite the initial anger, Baena insists the squad is completely ready to move forward together. "We would have supported him regardless of what he decided to do," the midfielder added. "The important thing is that he is with us now, and we need to show him all the affection in the world." Simeone backs his star forward Diego Simeone is also eager to put the disruption behind them and focus entirely on the current campaign. Speaking at a press conference on Sunday, the manager stated that the club is patiently waiting for the striker to return to his best form. "He's a great player and we love him," Simeone told reporters. The Argentine coach will rely heavily on his forward.

item.title: Chrome zero-day whack-a-mole continues as 2026 tally hits 8
item.description: Google has patched its eighth actively exploited Chrome zero-day of 2026, matching its total for the whole of last year with nearly two months still left on the calendar. The latest flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-125350, is a high-severity use-after-free vulnerability in Chrome's XML component. Google confirmed in a security advisory published Monday that attackers are already exploiting the bug, although it hasn't said who's behind the attacks or who might be getting targeted. "Google is aware that an exploit for CVE-2026-125350 exists in the wild," the company said, offering little else about the attacks. The vulnerability was reported anonymously on November 6 and involves a memory management error that occurs when software continues using a pointer to memory that has already been freed. Such bugs can potentially allow attackers to corrupt memory and execute malicious code, although Google hasn't disclosed how this particular flaw is being exploited. Google is keeping further technical details under wraps until enough users have installed the fix, a familiar approach intended to stop other attackers from getting their hands on a working exploit. The patch arrives in Chrome 157.0.8103.50/.51 for Windows and macOS, and 157.0.8103.50 for Linux. The update also addresses eight other security vulnerabilities, including high-severity flaws affecting WebGL, FileSystem, GPU, Compositing, and the V8 JavaScript engine. The release fixes another use-after-free bug in Chrome's XML component, CVE-2026-125346, which was reported by Arni Hardarson of Neonix Security in October, though Google hasn't indicated that this second vulnerability is being exploited. The latest discovery adds to what's becoming a rather long list of Chrome zero-days this year. By June, Google had already patched five actively exploited Chrome zero-days , including flaws in its V8 JavaScript engine, Skia graphics library, and WebGPU implementation. The list has only grown since then, with two more V8 bugs fixed in September and the latest XML vulnerability bringing the total to eight. That puts 2026 level with 2025, when Google also fixed eight Chrome zero-days exploited in the wild. Whether the browser maker can make it through the remaining weeks of the year without adding another to the pile is anyone's guess. Google says the latest update will roll out over the coming days and weeks, but users can check manually by heading to Chrome's Settings menu and selecting About Chrome. With attackers already making use of the vulnerability, it's probably worth doing that sooner rather than waiting for Chrome to get around to it. ®

item.title: Don’t Bench LaNorris Sellers If He Is Healthy For Arkansas
item.description: South Carolina Gamecocks quarterback LaNorris Sellers (16) throws a pass during a college football game between the University of Oklahoma Sooners (OU) and the South Carolina Gamecocks at Gaylord Family-Oklahoma Memorial Stadium in Norman, Okla., Saturday, Oct. 31, 2026. South Carolina won 42-25. The temptation to bench LaNorris Sellers for Saturday night against Arkansas is strong, but the move would be a mistake if he can go. South Carolina coach Shane Beamer told reporters on Sunday that the team expects their star quarterback to play despite the ankle injury. Beamer stated, “We fully expect him to play,” after Sellers completed medical tests that day, according to a report . The Gamecocks need their Heisman Trophy candidate on the field to keep their playoff hopes alive. Sellers showed his toughness by limping to a 41-yard touchdown in the win over Texas A&M on Saturday. He hurt his ankle in the second quarter but returned to finish the game. While he did not look like his usual self during the second half, the coaching staff designed plays to protect him. Beamer noted, “We feel good about his availability this weekend,” regarding the upcoming matchup. The only real concern is his pain tolerance and the swelling in that ankle, not a structural failure. The Trap Game Warning Pretty much the entire season has been dreadful for Arkansas, with just one SEC win. This makes the game a trap for the Gamecocks, especially with a night game in the SEC always scary for fans who have followed the program for decades. A loss to the Razorbacks would end all talk about a College Football Playoff spot and a second Heisman Trophy winner for the school. The upcoming showdown against Georgia in two weeks will hold no significance on the national stage if the team loses this weekend. Resting Sellers only makes sense if the injury is a high ankle sprain that could take weeks to heal. Beamer did not confirm it is that type of injury, though he acknowledged the swelling needs to go down. If the medical staff clears him, sitting him on the sideline is a risk the team cannot afford. The team should only consider resting him if they build a sizeable lead in the second half to avoid further injury. Heisman Stakes and Final Games Winning the last three games puts the Gamecocks in the College Football Playoff and secures a trip to New York for Sellers. Fans on social media think resting him is in the best interest of the team, but that logic fails if the opponent is weak. The priority is winning now, not protecting the quarterback for a future game that might not happen. Although Sellers skipped practice on Sunday evening and the Gamecocks do not train on Mondays, the coach remains confident. Beamer said, “Right now, it’s nothing that concerns us aside from his pain tolerance and getting some of the swelling down in that ankle.” The team will know more after the final medical review before the game.

Resting Sellers only makes sense if the injury is a high ankle sprain that could take weeks to heal. Beamer did not confirm it is that type of injury, though he acknowledged the swelling needs to go down. If the medical staff clears him, sitting him on the sideline is a risk the team cannot afford. The team should only consider resting him if they build a sizeable lead in the second half to avoid further injury. Heisman Stakes and Final Games Winning the last three games puts the Gamecocks in the College Football Playoff and secures a trip to New York for Sellers. Fans on social media think resting him is in the best interest of the team, but that logic fails if the opponent is weak. The priority is winning now, not protecting the quarterback for a future game that might not happen. Although Sellers skipped practice on Sunday evening and the Gamecocks do not train on Mondays, the coach remains confident. Beamer said, “Right now, it’s nothing that concerns us aside from his pain tolerance and getting some of the swelling down in that ankle.” The team will know more after the final medical review before the game.

item.title: Will Vikings Trade for QB After Disastrous Night for Wentz?
item.description: Nov 9, 2026; Minneapolis, Minnesota, USA; Minnesota Vikings quarterback Carson Wentz (11) reacts after a play during the third quarter against the Buffalo Bills at U.S. Bank Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Matt Krohn-Imagn Images The Minnesota Vikings face a harsh reality after a disastrous Monday Night Football loss. Coach Kevin O’Connell refused to commit to a quarterback trade despite a historic collapse by Carson Wentz. The team sits at a crossroads following a 6-0 start that has turned into consecutive losses. O’Connell deferred to general manager Nolan Teasley after the 23-6 defeat to the Buffalo Bills on Monday night. A Historic Low for Wentz Carson Wentz delivered the worst performance by any starting quarterback in the NFL this season, before being replaced by Max Brosmer in the fourth quarter. Only 8 of 25 passes were completed for 81 yards, alongside two interceptions thrown. His 2.3 QBR marks the lowest score for any player in the league this year. This number is also the lowest for a Vikings quarterback since Tarvaris Jackson in 2006. ESPN reported that this was the third game this season where the team failed to score a touchdown. Troy Aikman voiced his frustration on the ESPN broadcast after the game. Aikman noted that Wentz nearly threw an interception at the end of the third quarter. “I haven’t had many starts over the last couple of years in general,” Wentz said, “but this one felt pretty terrible. I’m not going to lie. Yeah, this one wasn’t my favorite, that’s for sure.” Coach Owes the Fix O’Connell admitted he failed to get Wentz into a rhythm during the game. He tried various tools to help the quarterback but acknowledged the mistake. “We never got Carson in a rhythm,” Vikings coach Kevin O’Connell said in his postgame press conference. The coach noted that he should have run the ball more rather than forcing passes on third down. An off-target rate of 38 percent ended the game for Wentz, representing the lowest figure in an NFL match this season. O’Connell said he wanted a balanced offense, but the plan fell apart. The Vikings are now stuck with a roster that cannot score points . O’Connell stated he would focus on the next game rather than immediate roster changes. “We’ve had dialogue about a lot of different positions,” O’Connell said. “Tight turnaround, obviously, playing the Monday night game, and we’ll get right to work on any potential moves that can be there. But really just focused on the game tonight, which was not good enough in any way, shape, or form.” The team must find a way to address the offense without waiting until the trade deadline passes.

item.title: Hornets’ Scoring Gap Widens As Cavaliers Prepare For Tuesday Clash
item.description: Vincent Carchietta-Imagn Images The Charlotte Hornets are averaging just 96.3 points per game, a number that looks low compared to the 117.0 points the Cleveland Cavaliers score every night. The home team trails the Cavaliers by a significant offensive margin as they prepare for Tuesday’s game, with the Cavaliers on a winning streak and the Hornets still searching for consistency. According to ESPN , the Hornets have lost their last six games in a row. That slide puts them in a bad spot right before they host a team that scores nearly 21 more points per game than they do. Two Teams in Different Spots Donovan Mitchell leads the Cavaliers with 24.0 points per game. He also shoots 48.8% from the field and 77.0% from the free-throw line, according to ESPN. His numbers show why Cleveland is so hard to stop. On the other side, Brandon Miller is the top scorer for the Hornets with 20.6 points per game. But Miller is shooting just 35.6% from the field. The difference in shooting efficiency is clear. Cleveland makes 46% of their shots while the Hornets only make 39% per ESPN. That seven-point gap in field goal percentage is a big reason why the Hornets have lost so many games lately. The Hornets also struggle to move the ball. They average 20.8 assists per game. The Cavaliers move the ball much better with 27.0 assists per game. More passes lead to better shots, and that helps explain the scoring difference. The Hornets need to find a way to get more players involved if they want to stop the bleeding. Without better ball movement, they will keep facing the same issues on Tuesday night. Key Players Sidelined Injuries are hurting both teams before the game starts. The Hornets will be without Brandon Miller for Tuesday night because he has a groin injury. He is listed as out with an estimated return date of November 12. Dennis Schroder is also out with a hamstring injury and will not return until November 25. This leaves the Hornets with a thin bench. Grant Williams is out too, with a hamstring injury that keeps him away until November 12. Kon Knueppel is out for a long time, with a return not expected until December 12. The Cavaliers have their own issues. Sam Merrill is out with an elbow injury and is expected back on November 11. Jarrett Allen is listed as game-time decision for Tuesday with a knee injury. His status was uncertain as of November 9. Jaylon Tyson is out with an ankle injury and will not return until November 11. These absences change how both teams play. The Hornets are missing their leading scorer and a key guard. The Cavaliers are missing a shooter and their starting center. The game could come down to who has more healthy players on the floor. The Cavaliers have their own issues. Sam Merrill is out with an elbow injury and is expected back on November 11. Jarrett Allen is listed as game-time decision for Tuesday with a knee injury. The Hornets are missing their leading scorer and a key guard. The Cavaliers are missing a shooter and their starting center. The game could come down to who has more healthy players on the floor. Ken Blaze-Imagn Images Recent Results Show the Trend The recent games show a clear pattern for both sides. The Hornets lost to the Boston Celtics on November 7 by a score of 119-80. They also lost to Brooklyn on November 5 with a score of 114-104. Before that, they fell to Detroit 124-91 on November 3. The Hornets allowed 110.2 points against per game this season. That number is high, but their offense is the bigger problem. They only score 96.3 points per game. The Cavaliers allow 114.1 points against per game, but they score so much that it does not matter as much. Cleveland beat Philadelphia on November 7 with a score of 119-95. They also beat Milwaukee on November 1 with a score of 136-111. Even with the losses, the Hornets have some bright spots. Moussa Diabate averages 9.1 rebounds per game, which is more than Evan Mobley’s 8.1 rebounds for the Cavaliers. Diabate is listed as game-time decision for Tuesday with a quadriceps injury. If he plays, he could help the Hornets control the boards. The Hornets also average 4.8 blocks per game compared to the Cavaliers’ 5.5. The steal numbers are close, with Cleveland at 7.2 and Charlotte at 7.0 per game. The Hornets need to use their defense to keep the game close. If they can slow down Mitchell and the Cavaliers, they might have a chance. The Cavaliers take on the Hornets on Tuesday, November 10, 2026.

item.title: Watch: Gabriel Jesus left amazed by Barcelona teammate’s performance vs Atletico Madrid
item.description: Watch: Gabriel Jesus left amazed by Barcelona teammate’s performance vs Atletico Madrid Barcelona’s midfield maestro Pedri may have had a topsy turvy campaign so far, with his lowest point coming in the defeat against Real Madrid. The Spaniard was criticised for his lack of impact in El Clasico . This is coupled with the fact that Pedri is also not a regular for the Spanish national team. However, in Barcelona’s win over Atletico Madrid, Pedri once again showed what he is capable of, producing a solid performance even in the absence of the injured Rodri. Gabriel Jesus hails Pedri’s performance Pedri’s performance against Atletico Madrid did not go unnoticed either, with his own teammate Gabriel Jesus in awe of his display at the Metropolitano. As captured by the Movistar cameras, the Barça new signing was seen speaking to Alejandro Balde on the bench, where he praised Pedri’s performance. “What a player Pedri. An incredible player ,” said the Brazilian, who was left as an unused substitute in the narrow win over Atleti. Balde, too, responded to Gabriel Jesus’ comment, agreeing with the Brazilian’s assessment. “It is very good bro,” he replied. The comments from the two Barcelona stars is hardly surprising as Pedri was indeed a key operator in the middle of the park, especially in the second half where he was able to instill more control to the game and help Barcelona complete the comeback. Road ahead for Pedri Pedri played a crucial role in Barcelona’s win over Atletico Madrid. (Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images) The performance against Pedri should serve as a major confidence booster for Pedri, as he heads to the international break. The Barcelona star is a part of the Spanish contingent, which is expected to take on Czechia and England in the UEFA Nations League. Pedri is expected to feature prominently in both the matches, given that Rodri is no longer available to Luis de la Fuente due to an injury. Barcelona will hope Pedri can avoid any injuries, considering the fact that Rodri is already unavailable while Frenkie de Jong has just returned from a long injury layoff. Hansi Flick has already taken great care in maintaining game-time for Pedri. It will be disappointing if the Spaniard picks up an unfortunate knock during this international break.

item.title: Cam Skattebo, Patrick Mahomes, Puka Nacua & more NFL injury updates entering Week 10
item.description: The NFL is heading into Week 10 with several notable injury situations to monitor, including updates on Cam Skattebo, Patrick Mahomes, A.J. Brown, Puka Nacua, and Josh Jacobs. Some teams received encouraging news about key players potentially returning, while others are preparing to be without important contributors. Here’s the latest on seven players whose availability could have an impact on the upcoming week. MORE: 3 NFL teams that should be worried after Week 9 Encouraging injury updates for Skattebo, Mahomes and A.J. Brown Oct 25, 2026; Seattle, Washington, USA; Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes (15) passes the ball against the Seattle Seahawks during the first quarter at Lumen Field. Mandatory Credit: Joe Nicholson-Imagn Images Cam Skattebo, New York Giants (hamstring) Skattebo was close to returning for Sunday’s game against the Philadelphia Eagles, but the Giants ultimately decided to hold him out. Head coach John Harbaugh now expects the running back to be a full go for Thursday night’s matchup against the Washington Commanders. His return would be a significant boost to a Giants offense that struggled to establish its ground game without him. Patrick Mahomes, Kansas City Chiefs (elbow) Mahomes is considered day-to-day after injuring his throwing elbow during Sunday’s win over the New York Jets. Head coach Andy Reid provided encouraging news, saying the quarterback’s initial evaluation was more positive than negative. An MRI reportedly showed no major damage, but Mahomes will continue to be monitored throughout the week. His practice participation will be worth watching as Kansas City prepares for Week 10. A.J. Brown, New England Patriots (knee) The Patriots are planning for Brown to travel with the team to Germany for Sunday’s matchup against the Detroit Lions, according to head coach Mike Vrabel. Brown has missed the team’s last two games because of his knee issue, but the plan to bring him overseas is an encouraging development. Traveling with the team does not guarantee that he will play, and New England will continue evaluating his availability. item.title: Dan Orlovsky says what he’s seen Jordan Love do is ‘breaking the rules of football’
item.description: Photo by M. Anthony Nesmith/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images After a shaky start to the season, the Green Bay Packers are establishing themselves as one of the real forces in the NFC. Jordan Love continues to impress at quarterback, and Sunday’s game against the New England Patriots was one of his best yet. On a day when Drake Maye threw three interceptions, Love ended the game having thrown for three touchdowns and 372 yards. It is hard not to be blown away by the level of football Love is currently playing at, and Dan Orlovsky has now even suggested that the standard being set by Love is so good that it is actually ‘breaking the laws of football’. Dan Orlovsky thinks no quarterback is playing better than Jordan Love Through his opening nine games of the season, Love has thrown 19 touchdowns and six interceptions. No other quarterback has thrown for more yards (2,618) than Love this season, with Orlovsky left staggered by how well the Packers’ QB is currently playing. “Realistically, guys, there is no reason Jordan Love should be playing this well. He should not be playing this well, and he just continues to play at a level that is very rare. Stephen A., they have drops, they have penalties, this is a makeshift offensive line, and they cannot run the football. Quarterbacks in that setting should not play as well as he is playing. He is breaking the rules of football, that is what he is doing. “It is not just that Jordan Love is playing at an MVP level. Jordan Love is breaking the rules of football right now, and that speaks to the context of how well he is playing.” However, Stephen A. Smith hit back at Orlovsky, claiming that he needs to see Love play at this level when it matters in the postseason. It has been six years since the Packers made it to the Conference Championship game, with consecutive years of being knocked out at the Wild Card Round over the last two years. “He can play. I’ve always said that. What I have said was I want to see him look the same come playoff time. And I got news for you, D.O., that opinion has not changed,” Smith replied. item.title: ‘Great dude’ – Logan Ryan reveals which quarterback has impressed him most this season
item.description: Photo by Ryan Kang/Getty Images Logan Ryan recently made an appearance on the Up & Adams show and was quizzed on which quarterback has impressed him most in the NFL this term. Josh Allen continues to earn plaudits for the Buffalo Bills after another stellar showing in their most recent game against the Minnesota Vikings. Caleb Williams is also shining for the Chicago Bears this season. But Ryan has now come out and urged people to put some respect on Brock Purdy’s name. When Adams asked Ryan which quarterback has impressed him the most this season, he responded: “You know what, I got to go with, I got to go with, man, my guy Purdy. Put some respect on Purdy’s name. “Fred says all the time, this guy was, what is it, Mr Irrelevant last draft pick. “He’s getting it done all ways man against all odds, I love Purdy for that. Purdy and I did like breath work before every single practice. We did this thing where we practice our breathing. He has a nice little meditation thing he does and it gets him in the zone. He puts a lot of work in behind the scenes. “He’s a great dude, a great teammate. Put some respect on Purdy in the MVP race.” Purdy has 1,980 passing yards this season with a completion rate of 69.1 per cent as well as 17 touchdowns. His impressive form has helped the San Francisco 49ers go 7-1 so far, with their next outing taking place this Sunday against the 4-5 Dallas Cowboys. item.title: Real Madrid forward receives much-needed support from national teammates amid struggles
item.description: Real Madrid forward receives much-needed support from national teammates amid struggles Vinicius Jr. is going through a difficult spell at Real Madrid, but the forward continues to enjoy strong backing within the Brazil national team, where Carlo Ancelotti is confident he can help him recover his best form. According to AS , there is a strong belief among his international teammates that the Italian coach understands how to get the best out of the winger and can help him overcome his current struggles. The aforementioned claim is quite understandable because Ancelotti and Vinicius together enjoyed one of the most successful runs in Real Madrid’s history. Notably, the contrast between Vinicius’ club and international situations is becoming quite significant because at Madrid, his place in Jose Mourinho’s starting line-up has come under pressure following Yan Diomande’s emergence . In the national team setup, however, he remains an important figure under Ancelotti. Diomande’s emergence increases pressure on Vinicius at Real Madrid Vinicius Jr. is struggling for form this season. (Photo by Paolo Bruno/Getty Images) Vinicius’ difficult start to the season has given Mourinho a genuine selection dilemma . The Brazilian has managed just one goal and three assists in 12 appearances for Real Madrid, a return below the standards expected from a player who has previously been one of the club’s most influential attacking threats. Diomande, on his part, has made the competition more difficult. The Ivorian has impressed with his performances and offered Mourinho a productive alternative on the left wing. His emergence has also allowed the coach to make changes without weakening the team’s attacking threat. Brazil national team camp feels Ancelotti will help restore Vinicius’ form. (Photo by Wagner Meier/Getty Images) Vinicius is therefore no longer guaranteed a starting position, and Mourinho has also made clear that selection will depend on performances, although his public comments and treatment of the Brazilian indicate that he still wants to help him recover his best level . Ancelotti could provide the confidence Vinicius needs The international break offers Vinicius an opportunity to work with a coach who understands his game particularly well. Ancelotti helped develop the Brazilian into a decisive attacker during their time together at Real Madrid, and their relationship is an important source of confidence for the forward. The optimism within the Brazil camp is significant because Vinicius needs to rediscover the qualities that made him so difficult to defend against and for that, he needs support from teammates, be it from Brazil or from Real Madrid.

item.title: ‘So washed’ – NFL fans call out Troy Aikman over ‘ridiculous’ MNF comment
item.description: Photo by Michael Reaves/Getty Images The Minnesota Vikings fans were left with very little to applaud on Monday night against the Buffalo Bills, but Byron Murphy’s interception on Josh Allen certainly impressed Troy Aikman. Allen was able to throw for 234 yards on Monday night in Minnesota, but the Vikings’ incredible defense was able to limit him to just one touchdown thrown. The Bills’ quarterback attempted a 36-yard touchdown pass in the first quarter, which was intercepted by Murphy. As the Vikings’ cornerback returned it to around the halfway line, Aikman was left waxing lyrical about the interception: “One of the best plays I’ve ever seen.” Although no one will deny Murphy’s interception and return was impressive, there was a clear feeling among fans online that perhaps Aikman was taking his comments a little too far. NFL fans hit back at Troy Aikman’s praise of Byron Murphy’s interception DJ Moore was the intended receiver for Allen’s pass, but Murphy was able to fly in there and come away with the ball. A seriously impressive play, but one of the best ever seen? That felt like a slight exaggeration from Aikman . ‘Aikman is over it,’ replied one fan on X after seeing the clip of Aikman’s commentary. ‘Aikman is just there so he doesn’t get fined,’ another fan jokingly said in relation to Marshawn Lynch’s iconic interview. The colour commentator’s future with ESPN remains hanging in the balance as no new deal has been agreed between the two parties. Aikman’s commentary on Monday night clearly left a lot of people feeling as if he is now simply seeing out his time with the network. ‘That’s ridiculous, he would say that…’ replied another fan. ‘Troy is checked out,’ added another. Tony Romo featured on ESPN’s alternative coverage of Monday Night Football on the Field Pass show, which has left a number of viewers feeling as if the former CBS commentator was being ‘soft launched’ as Aikman’s future successor. ‘Troy so hyperbolic lol,’ one fan responded. ‘Hang them up Troy you are so washed,’ another even said. item.title: Kompany returns to Bayern’s training ground for first time since collapse
item.description: By Adegboyega Adeleye Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany returned to the club’s training ground on Tuesday for the first time since collapsing last month, beginning a gradual return to work ahead of the Bundesliga match against Cologne on November 20. The 40-year-old was at Bayern’s Säbener Straße complex shortly after 10am, according to German media reports. He worked from his office, spoke with assistant coach Floribert Ngalula and sporting director Christoph Freund, and watched injured players complete a recovery session. His return to the training ground does not mean he has resumed all his duties, as he is expected back in the dugout after the international break. Kompany collapsed on October 23 while watching a training session involving Bayern’s reserve team. He was hospitalised and diagnosed with meningeal irritation, an inflammation affecting the tissue around the brain or spinal cord. He was later discharged to recover at home. Assistant Aaron Danks took charge during Kompany’s absence, overseeing four wins and a 2-2 draw with Borussia Dortmund. Bayern beat Freiburg, Magdeburg, Atlético Madrid and Mainz. Danks said the club had instructed him to keep football discussions away from Kompany while he recovered. “I have clear instructions from Max [Eberl] and Christoph [Freund] not to engage in discussions, first of all, and to keep Vince focused on nothing other than his health and spending time with his family,” he said. “We want him to rest and recover properly so that, when he returns, he is fully fit and can help us in the best possible way. We are being very strict here and keeping football completely out of it.” Kompany’s father, Pierre, had previously described his son’s demanding work routine in an interview with Bild. “He works 18 hours a day most days and, on a typical day, barely sees his children,” he said, adding that Kompany was often at the training ground early and left late. Bayern are scheduled to host Cologne on November 20, when Kompany is expected to return to the touchline. The post Kompany returns to Bayern’s training ground for first time since collapse appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Wainwright gives Wales injury scare for All Blacks
item.description: Aaron Wainwright joined Leicester from Dragons for the start of the 2025-26 season [Huw Evans Picture Agency] Number eight Aaron Wainwright has emerged as a major injury concern for the Nations Championship game against New Zealand in Cardiff on Saturday. The 29-year-old picked up a leg injury and has since been seen in a protective boot. He did not train on Tuesday. Head coach Steve Tandy will name his team on Thursday and absence of the former Dragons player would be a major blow. Wainwright started in the 28-21 victory against Japan last Saturday and was the most experienced forward in the squad. The Leicester number eight, who was winning his 71st cap, is also Wales' most effective forward ball-carrier. New Zealand wing Will Jordan will miss the game because of a hamstring injury but centre Jordie Barrett is available for selection to face Wales after passing his head injury assessment (HIA) protocols. Smiling Rees-Zammit has no fear of All Blacks Wales should make fly-half change - Shanklin Basham in pole position Recalled Taine Basham would be the leading contender to replace Wainwright on Saturday, with Scarlets back-rower Taine Plumtree providing the other option in the squad. Basham was rewarded with a squad call-up having been the form number eight in Welsh domestic rugby this season. The Cardiff number eight has not played for Wales since the 2024 Six Nations, while his previous start to that was in 2022. After the All Blacks match, Wales will host Australia on 21 November, before the Nations Championship finals weekend at the end of the month, hosted by the Allianz Stadium at Twickenham. Wales currently lie fifth out of sixth in the northern hemisphere table after two wins from four matches. Wales let themselves down despite win - Lake Why Wales have a lot to prove despite beating Japan Fixtures and standings as Nations Championship returns

item.title: 2026 DP World Tour Championship: How to watch Rory McIlroy, Jon Rahm and more
item.description: The Race to Dubai comes to an end on the Earth Course at Jumeirah Golf Estates this week where leader Eugenio Chacarra looks to hold off challengers Rory McIlroy and Patrick Reed. McIlroy is the favorite to capture the DP World Tour Championship but can he tie Colin Montgomerie's mark of eight career RTD titles or will Jon Rahm play spoiler after his late-season win in Abu Dhabi? Golf Channel and Golf Channel mobile will carry live action from the United Arab Emirates, beginning in the early hours of Thursday morning. Here's a day-by-day breakdown of when to watch on TV (all times in EST): Thursday, November 12 2-8AM: DP World Tour Championship, Round 1 Friday, November 13 2-8AM: DP World Tour Championship, Round 2 Saturday, November 14 2-8AM: DP World Tour Championship, Round 3 Sunday, November 15 1:30-7:30AM: DP World Tour Championship, final round Race to Dubai title up for grabs as McIlroy, Chacarra and Reed enter DP World Tour finale The 2026 golf season on the DP World Tour reaches its climax this week with a traditional trip to the Earth course at Jumeirah Golf Estates in Dubai for the 50 leading players on the points list. item.title: CFP Rankings Reset: 4 Mysteries Facing The Committee
item.description: Nov 7, 2026; South Bend, Indiana, USA; Miami Hurricanes running back Javian Mallory (21) is tackled by the Notre Dame Fighting Irish during the fourth quarter at Notre Dame Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Trevor Ruszkowski-Imagn Images A significant shakeup at the chart’s summit awaits when the second College Football Playoff ranking round arrives. Ohio State will likely fall out of the top 20 after a loss to Oregon, while Georgia prepares to reclaim the No. 1 spot. The selection committee must also decide where to place Notre Dame after its loss to Miami and how to handle the messy group of three-loss teams in the SEC. These four questions define the chaos heading into Tuesday night. A chaotic weekend has left the committee with no easy answers. The rankings released on Tuesday night will show a new leader at the top, but the path to the playoff remains unclear for several teams. According to USA TODAY , this second ranking round will resolve several major questions that emerged over the weekend. The uncertainty centers on five specific teams that could change the entire race for the four playoff spots. Can Utah Leapfrog Georgia for No. 1? Utah has a strong case, backed by an unbeaten record and a dominant win over Brigham Young . The Utes also blew out a solid Arkansas team by 33 points in September. Despite these wins, it is highly unlikely they will jump Georgia for the top spot. The committee values Georgia’s road wins against Alabama and Ole Miss far more than Utah’s conference victories. Since suffering defeat against the Tigers early this season, the Bulldogs have remained the most consistently dominant Power Four squad. While the BYU win helps Utah’s résumé, the eye test favors the Bulldogs. Georgia has proven it can win on the road against tough opponents, a key factor for the committee. The Utes have had a great season, but the path to No. 1 is blocked by Georgia’s résumé. Per USA TODAY, the committee won’t place as much value on the BYU win as they will the Bulldogs’ road successes. This leaves Utah in a strong position but still behind the defending national champions. How Far Does Ohio State Fall? Ohio State faces a steep drop in the rankings after falling to 6-3 with a loss to Oregon. This marks the second straight loss for the Buckeyes, who are now barely hanging on to the edge of the playoff race. Ranked No. 12 last week, the team will likely stay in the Top 25 but could slide to around No. 20. This new spot mirrors their position in the US LBM Coaches Poll released after the game. The Buckeyes will sit behind two other three-loss teams, Ole Miss and Oregon, in the new order. They should still remain above LSU and South Carolina, though their margin for error has vanished. The loss to Oregon hurts their standing significantly, and a second loss has burned through the team’s goodwill. USA TODAY reports that the Buckeyes barely hang on to the outer edges of the at-large playoff contention. Their chance to reach the Big Ten championship

Utah has a strong case, backed by an unbeaten record and a dominant win over Brigham Young . The Utes also blew out a solid Arkansas team by 33 points in September. Since suffering defeat against the Tigers early this season, the Bulldogs have remained the most consistently dominant Power Four squad. The Utes have had a great season, but the path to No. 1 is blocked by Georgia’s résumé. Per USA TODAY, the committee won’t place as much value on the BYU win as they will the Bulldogs’ road successes. This leaves Utah in a strong position but still behind the defending national champions. How Far Does Ohio State Fall? Ohio State faces a steep drop in the rankings after falling to 6-3 with a loss to Oregon. This marks the second straight loss for the Buckeyes, who are now barely hanging on to the edge of the playoff race. Ranked No. 12 last week, the team will likely stay in the Top 25 but could slide to around No. 20. This new spot mirrors their position in the US LBM Coaches Poll released after the game. The Buckeyes will sit behind two other three-loss teams, Ole Miss and Oregon, in the new order. They should still remain above LSU and South Carolina, though their margin for error has vanished. The loss to Oregon hurts their standing significantly, and a second loss has burned through the team’s goodwill. USA TODAY reports that the Buckeyes barely hang on to the outer edges of the at-large playoff contention. Their chance to reach the Big Ten championship game is now slim. Will Miami Stay Ahead of Notre Dame? The committee previously honored Miami’s head-to-head win against Notre Dame from a year ago. This move bumped the Hurricanes into the tournament in last season’s final rankings. Now, the question is if Miami can stay ahead of the Irish after a road loss . There are two reasons the Hurricanes might remain in front. First, the loss came with a major caveat: Miami played without star receiver Malachi Toney for the first time this season. Historical precedents indicate the committee evaluates losses differently if a team lacks an elite player. While this has usually applied to quarterbacks, Toney’s absence is a significant factor. Yahoo Sports notes the committee ultimately recognized Miami’s head-to-head victory from a year prior, elevating the Hurricanes above Notre Dame. If the committee follows this pattern, the lack of Toney could protect Miami’s ranking despite the defeat to the Irish. What About the Three-Loss SEC Teams? One major unknown concerns the committee’s method for ranking the numerous SEC teams carrying three losses. Will the rankings show that it is curtains for the Buckeyes, LSU, and Missouri? LSU has taken tough losses to Alabama and one-score losses to Kentucky and Ole Miss. Meanwhile, Oregon and South Carolina sit comfortably ahead of the Tigers despite their own flaws. Illinois and Oklahoma State defeated Oregon, while South Carolina lost to Mississippi State. LSU should be ranked higher given the quality of their losses compared to other teams. Texas handed Missouri a disputed loss, causing the team to exit the Top 25 entirely. The Tigers lost to Ole Miss, Mississippi State, and Texas, all of which are strong teams. Yahoo Sports mentions that aside from the many other three-loss SEC squads, Ohio State is now a train wreck. The committee must decide if these losses are acceptable for playoff consideration. The final rankings will reveal if the committee values strength of schedule over win-loss records. The chaos of the weekend has left fans waiting to see who gets the final spots. The five mysteries outlined above will determine the landscape for the rest of the season. Following its massive victory over former No. 1 Miami, the selection committee must determine Notre Dame’s placement and the extent of the Hurricanes’ decline. These decisions will shape the playoff picture for the next few weeks. The new rankings drop tonight on ESPN.

item.title: Even ‘Pawn Stars’ star has thoughts on Yankees’ fed-up fans
item.description: LAS VEGAS — As usual, the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop was crowded last Friday afternoon. The parking lot was filled and rideshare vehicles pulled in constantly for drop-offs and pickups. The Vegas tourist trap that’s a few miles off the Strip on Las Vegas Boulevard is the filming location of one of the most successful reality TV shows, History Channel’s “Pawn Stars,” which is about to start its 24th season. Few customers show up to sell or pawn. They’re there to gaze at big-money merchandise they’ve seen purchased on TV and leave with T-shirts, ballcaps, bobbleheads and countless other souvenirs of the original cast — owner Rick Harrison, co-founder and late father Richard “Old Man” Harrison, son Corey “Big Hoss” Harrison and wildly popular family friend Austin “Chumlee” Russell. After a long morning, Rick Harrison initially turned down a request to talk baseball for a few minutes with a Yankees beat writer who traveled to Vegas for this week’s General Managers Meetings. Harrison was talked into granting the interview with a little nudging from his longtime director of operations, a lifelong Yankees fan. Brooklyn native Andy Spyer is the employee who ends up with all the Yankees World Series rings purchased by Gold & Silver, and he wore one to work last Friday. Harrison, 61, isn’t a Yankees expert but knows a little about almost everything from nearly four decades in the pawn business. He’s also a sports fan who is excited about the Athletics moving to Vegas in 2028. Over the past month, the Yankees have taken heat from fans, star alumni and even the Brewers manager , who took a shot during his on-field World Series celebration. NJ.com asked Harrison if he had an opinion. He did. Harrison’s big-picture view wasn’t another shot at the Yankees’ clubhouse culture or a lack of fundamentals. His outsider’s perspective focused on Yankees fans being fed up with a championship drought that is now 17 years. Standing in the back courtyard of Gold & Silver, the spot where customers try to sell classic cars on “Pawn Stars” episodes, Harrison said, “because a lot of Yankees fans are uber, uber fans, they get way too emotional over it. They sit around and they all think they could manage the team better. “It’s sports. Sometimes the mojo doesn’t work and you’re going to have a bad year, even if you spend a lot of money,” Harrison said. Bad years for the Yankees typically mean contending with one of baseball’s biggest payrolls, reaching the playoffs most seasons and winning a round or two. “Remember, it’s sports where there’s a billion and one variables, and you’re never going to be able to figure them all out,” Harrison said. “If you get to the playoffs every year, God bless you, because look at other teams like the Padres.” The Padres have been Harrison’s team since he was a kid, so he understands fan frustration. They were an expansion team in 1969 and have never won a World Series. Harrison grew up in San Diego as the son of a Navy dad who was stationed there. T

They sit around and they all think they could manage the team better. “It’s sports. Sometimes the mojo doesn’t work and you’re going to have a bad year, even if you spend a lot of money,” Harrison said. Bad years for the Yankees typically mean contending with one of baseball’s biggest payrolls, reaching the playoffs most seasons and winning a round or two. “Remember, it’s sports where there’s a billion and one variables, and you’re never going to be able to figure them all out,” Harrison said. “If you get to the playoffs every year, God bless you, because look at other teams like the Padres.” The Padres have been Harrison’s team since he was a kid, so he understands fan frustration. They were an expansion team in 1969 and have never won a World Series. Harrison grew up in San Diego as the son of a Navy dad who was stationed there. The family home was in the Mission Valley section of town, about a mile from Jack Murphy Stadium. Harrison used to sneak into games with buddies in the late 1970s, before Hall of Fame outfielder Dave Winfield left the Padres for the Yankees. “We grew up right at the top of the hill from the stadium, and if you lived in my neighborhood, you knew how to break in,” he said. “Literally. I probably watched 40 or 50 games a year. This is when the Padres were lucky to get 5,000 people in the seats. “In the very back of the stadium, there was this lone ticket booth that was never opened. Before any Padres game, you’d see 15 kids sitting back there, sometimes as much as 25. And then you’d put your foot in the little metal thing where you put the money, the little hole in the window where they talk. “You’d grab the sign on top of that and you pulled yourself onto the roof. And there’s that big round building around it. I’m telling you, within two minutes, you would have 25 kids lying flat on that roof. And then one kid would look over and (yell), ‘Go!’ We’d all hang, drop, go up to general admission. We were all in. “I used to meet players, too.” The entrepreneurial spirit came courtesy of more youthful mischief. “Me and my buddy had a paper route when they changed the Sunday paper from 25 cents to 50 cents, which was a big deal,” he said. “We came up with a little racket.” On Sunday mornings, they’d buy one newspaper from a vending machine outside a 7-Eleven that was close to the stadium, then steal the rest. Players for the Padres and the Chargers used to stop there on the way to games for coffee and a newspaper. “We had our San Diego Union bags on our bikes and told them we were paper boys,” Harrison said with a laugh. “We’d say, ‘We noticed the machine was out. We had extras this morning.’ We’d make it an extra 15 bucks. We’d get like $7.50 apiece.” A lot older, wiser and richer, Harrison now supports Vegas’ two professional sports teams. He’s a season-ticket holder for the NHL’s Vegas Golden Knights and regularly attends Las Vegas Raiders NFL games. Harrison also plans to support the Athletics, whose move from Oakland to Vegas by way of a three-season stop in Sacramento is scheduled for 2028. That’s when their new ballpark will be ready. The 33,000-seat, retractable-roof ballpark already is rising on the Strip across Tropicana Avenue from the MGM Grand & Casino. Harrison predicts the Athletics, who have had five losing seasons in a row with low-payroll rosters, will regularly play to big crowds, regardless of whether ownership starts spending a lot more to build a winner. MORE BY RANDY MILLER Here’s what is drastically wrong with Yankees, and what has to change for a quick fix Nov. 7, 2026, 7:00 a.m. Red Sox do some poaching on Yankees Nov. 4, 2026, 9:16 p.m. “You’ve got to understand, it’s Vegas,” Harrison said. “If the people of the city don’t fill out seats, the tourists will. It’s just the nature of this town. I think the Raiders make more per seat than any other NFL franchise. We’ve embraced the Raiders. “We’ve embraced the Knights. Have you been to a Knights game? The entire ice is a video screen. Baseball will be just like that because we are Vegas, and it’s gonna be a show. “I really think baseball will work. I think the A’s will do great.” Read the original article on NJ.com . Add NJ.com as a Preferred Source by clicking here .

item.title: Bayern remain in talks to sign Liverpool's Rio Ngumoha
item.description: Bayern remain in talks to sign Liverpool's Rio Ngumoha Liverpool youngster Rio Ngumoha was one of the options Bayern Munich explored last summer as the German champions searched for a new winger. According to multiple reports, Bayern were ready to splurge around €70 million on the 18-year-old, but the move ultimately didn't materialise due to Liverpool's reluctance to sell, with the German champions instead going on to sign Ismael Saibari from PSV. In quotes published on his CfBayern Insider website, Bild's head of football Christian Falk has now shed further light on Bayern's interest in Ngumoha, claiming that the Bavarians remain in contact with the youngster's camp. “There were talks, his brother talked with FC Bayern, but it was a difficult situation for Bayern Munich. It was not clear if Liverpool would sell him or not. The price wouldn’t have been extremely high. So, you see, the club’s decision-makers feel he’d be a great option for Bayern Munich, which is why Ngumoha is still on Bayern’s shortlist," Falk said. “In the end, they had to decide for Ismael Saibari. Rio would have been complicated, so they just looked to seal the comparatively easier transfer of the two. Bayern are still in talks with Ngumoha’s camp, however, and he could be an option for the summer.” The young winger has made 14 appearances for Liverpool in all competitions this season, providing two assists.

item.title: De Gea’s Fiorentina tenure nearly over as Viola prepare to move on from ex-Man Utd goalkeeper
item.description: De Gea’s Fiorentina tenure nearly over as Viola prepare to move on from ex-Man Utd goalkeeper David De Gea’s time at Fiorentina could be coming to an end, with the Viola already looking at possible replacements for the former Manchester United goalkeeper. A ccording to Corriere dello Sport , the club have growing doubts about the 36-year-old because of his errors this season and his €3.5m net-a-year salary. Paolo Vanoli defended his captain after Sunday’s 2-2 draw with Juventus , insisting De Gea isn’t a problem. Even so, the Spaniard was at fault for Gleison Bremer’s goal in the 66th minute, when he started to come off his line for a cross and then stayed put. He has also made mistakes against Sassuolo, Como, Genoa, Frosinone and Roma, and coming for crosses, long a weakness, appears to have got worse with age. FLORENCE, ITALY – OCTOBER 29: David de Gea goalkeeper of ACF Fiorentina reacts after against goal of Torino FC Charles De Ketelaere of Atalanta BC during the Serie A match between ACF Fiorentina and Atalanta BC at Stadio Artemio Franchi on October 29, 2026 in Florence, Italy. (Photo by Gabriele Maltinti/Getty Images) Fiorentina’s options to replace De Gea The current back-ups, Oliver Christensen and Luca Lezzerini, aren’t seen as long-term solutions, and sporting director Fabio Paratici has started to look elsewhere. Tommaso Martinelli is the first option. The Fiorentina-owned goalkeeper is currently on loan at Serie B side Avellino. The club are also exploring the international market, and River Plate’s Santiago Beltrán, born in 2004, is among the names being linked. FLORENCE, ITALY – NOVEMBER 27: David de Gea goalkeeper of ACF Fiorentina looks on during the UEFA Conference League 2025/26 League Phase MD4 match between ACF Fiorentina and AEK Athens FC at Stadio Artemio Franchi on November 27, 2025 in Florence, Italy. (Photo by Gabriele Maltinti/Getty Images) The Corriere believes these could be De Gea’s final seven months in Florence.

item.title: Vincent Kompany returns to Bayern training ground with arm in a sling after collapse
item.description: Vincent Kompany has returned to Bayern Munich ’s training ground for the first time since his collapse . The 40-year-old fell ill during a reserve-team training session on Friday 23 October and was taken to hospital, where he was diagnosed with meningeal irritation . He had been unwell with a viral infection earlier that week, which forced him to miss the pre-match press conference ahead of Bayern’s visit of Arsenal in the Champions League. He was able to be on the touchline for that match, which took place two days before his collapse, but he was nevertheless subdued in the dugout. Vincent Kompany had already been struggling with a virus leading up to his collapse (Getty) The Bundesliga champions’ director of sport Max Eberl said his return would take “weeks, not days” as Bayern insisted he would only return when he was back to full health. And on Tuesday morning, Kompany was spotted at Bayern’s Sabener Strasse training complex, with German newspaper Bild circulating photos of the Belgian in the club’s offices. He appeared to have his left arm in a sling, which is said to be due to a dislocated shoulder suffered during the fall. The club have not yet put out a statement confirming his return. The Independent has contacted Bayern Munich for comment. More photos of Vincent Kompany back at his office at Säbener Straße today [📸 @BILD ] pic.twitter.com/UCl5D9KXIj — Bayern & Germany (@iMiaSanMia) November 10, 2026 Kompany could now be in contention to make his comeback in the dugout when Bayern host Koln on Friday 20 November after the international break. The club have won four and drawn one since assistant manager Aaron Danks took the reins from Kompany, only dropping points in a dramatic 2-2 draw with Borussia Dortmund in Der Klassiker. Bayern are top of the Bundesliga table with 21 points in nine games, level on points with Dortmund but ahead on goal difference. During Kompany’s time away, Bayern talisman and England captain Harry Kane has also brought the Ballon d’Or back to Bavaria , pipping Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe to football’s top individual prize. Harry Kane won the Ballon d’Or three days after Kompany collapsed (Getty) Kane paid tribute to Kompany in his acceptance speech , who was still in hospital at the time. He said: “To Vinnie, I know he's at home or I think still in the hospital so wishing you very well. Hope this has gave you a bit of energy. “To Vinnie and all the staff, the way we train, the way you push us, it's a credit to yourself. Since I've been with you, I've improved as a player, no doubt, improved as a person, as a leader, and that's thanks to your leadership.”

item.title: Atlanta Braves News: Rotation Outlook, Awards Week, More
item.description: As another offseason begins, the Braves have multiple needs to address to truly return to the being a true World Series contender. It is abundantly clear that more quality needs to be added to the Braves offense. However, reliable depth also needs to be added to the Braves rotation. A big reason for this is the significant injuries that have occurred to several young arms in the organization over the past few years. Grant McAuley dives more into the current state of the Braves internal options for the 2027 rotation. Braves News Ivan looks at whether or not this year’s GM meetings could be different than most years with the lockout looming. Mark Bowman looks a few of the bigger Braves storylines heading into the GM Meetings. MLB News Kevin McGonigle of the Tigers and Sal Stewart of the Reds were voted the AL and NL Rookies of the Year. Didier Fuentes received a few 5th place votes in the final results.

(Photo by Sean M. Haffey/Getty Images) Getty The Golden State Warriors started 0-3. They have now won eight in a row. The last time they won eight straight in a single season was 2021-22, the year they won the championship, per Nick Friedell of The Athletic. The last time the Warriors won eight straight was during the 2021-22 season. — Nick Friedell (@NickFriedell) November 10, 2026 Warriors Rout Pelicans for No. 8 The streak reached eight on Monday with a 138-87 win over the New Orleans Pelicans, who were on the second night of a back-to-back and without Zion Williamson and Trey Murphy III. It was the Warriors’ easiest win of the season. Golden State led 35-20 after one quarter and 72-43 at halftime. The win improved the Warriors to 8-3 and finished a perfect five-game homestand. Warriors’ Young Core Leads the Way Getty Brandin Podziemski of the Golden State Warriors. Stephen Curry scored 25 points on 6-of-10 shooting in under 21 minutes. Brandin Podziemski tied for the game high with 25 points, and Yaxel Lendeborg added 23 points, seven rebounds and four assists on 8-of-10 shooting. De’Anthony Melton scored 16, Charles Bassey had 12 and LJ Cryer had 10. Twelve of the 13 Warriors who played made at least one basket. Bassey also had the highlight of the night, blocking Derik Queen on a two-handed dunk attempt. Golden State Streak Echoes 2021-22 Getty Andrew Wiggins and Jordan Poole of the Golden State Warriors. The parallels are hard to ignore. The 2021-22 Warriors came off a season that ended in the play-in. Few outside the building trusted them to contend. Nobody was measuring that team for a banner. It rose anyway, on the backs of Andrew Wiggins and Jordan Poole , who stepped into the light when the franchise needed them. This year’s version has its own scar. The Warriors lost the Western Conference eight-seed battle to the Phoenix Suns last season. Then they opened 0-3. The story looked written, but it was not. Now Lendeborg and Podziemski are playing the part Wiggins and Poole once did. The streak is starting to look less like a hot stretch and more like an identity. Injuries Are Piling Up Getty Brandon Williams of the Golden State Warriors. The good news comes with a warning. Brandon Williams left Monday’s game after a couple of minutes with a left hamstring injury and will have an MRI on Tuesday. If he misses extended time, he would join Jimmy Butler , Moses Moody and Kristaps Porzingis on the list of Warriors out for a while. Will Richard is out indefinitely with a torn UCL in his left thumb, and Gary Payton II sat Monday with knee inflammation, though that is not expected to be a long absence. Steve Kerr called Brandon Williams' hamstring injury a "big concern." I was told Brandon has not had an MRI yet https://t.co/MfVGD3auLq — Dalton Johnson (@DaltonJ_Johnson) November 10, 2026 What’s Next for the Golden State Warriors The schedule gets harder now. The Warriors begin their first prolonged road trip of the season on Wednesday against the Houston Rockets , with tip-off at 6:30 p.m. Pacific. item.title: Jumbo Package: Alabama moves on to Vanderbilt
item.description: BATON ROUGE, LA - NOVEMBER 7: Luke Metz #4 of the Alabama Crimson Tide reacts after a stop against the LSU Tigers during the second half of a game at Tiger Stadium on November 7, 2026 in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. (Photo by Derick Hingle/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images) | Icon Sportswire via Getty Images With the Tide finishing off LSU last weekend, the hype is starting to build in Tuscaloosa again. That said, Vanderbilt looms, and while the Commodores are a far cry from the threat they posed the last couple of years with Diego Pavia, there’s still plenty of bad taste left in the mouth of the Alabama program. Kicking off the week, we have our usual round up of press conferences from the coaches: “I’ll give you guys the first line in the offensive staff meeting: I said no media line bullshit, but we got to focus more on the run game, and it’s got to get fixed,” he said. “We had such a good groove happening, and I thought LSU took us out of a couple things that we had early in the football game. We popped a couple runs early and got behind the sticks. Too many third and longs, too many second and longs. “I think for us, one of the huge focuses is how do we get the run game back and what do we got to do to get the ball in the right people’s hands.” Alabama freshman Trae’shawn Brown started at running back, running 11 times for 35 yards. Daniel Hill added 15 yards on five carries, while Kevin Riley was the only other running back to receive a snap, playing one. Sophomore AK Dear and freshman EJ Crowell were both listed as questionable on the availability report during the week before being upgraded and cleared to play Saturday. Both were in uniform for pregame warmups, with Crowell wearing a brace over his left knee, but neither played in the game. “They got to get healthy,” Grubb said. “They got to get healthy. It sucks. I’d love to give EJ the ball 32 times a game, but we just got to get him healthy, man. My heart breaks for both those kids because they’re tough as nails. They’ve got to go through it. They work their asses off every week to get back on the field, and we’re hoping. We hope every week. “I know, again, those guys are working so hard to get back out there. They’ve done a good job with staying on the preparation, doing their homework, doing the walk throughs, doing everything they’re supposed to do. EJ tried to give it a go before the game, and had the brace on, and just really wasn’t capable of doing that. We’re hopeful and obviously we’re lucky they’re not season-ending injuries or anything like that, and they’re just working to get healthy.” Grubb gave us plenty of good quotables this week, but the part that got the most time in airwaves was his talking about the run game. For my part, I have no issues with the way Grubb called this game (and I’ve had plenty of issues with Grubb in the past).
